purpose: Teach: 生殖/極度/入植/従属/太平洋戦争/払拭/多重/憎悪

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、動物の生殖行動を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote that paper on animal reproduction behavior, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Voice lifts slightly with gentle curiosity. Eye contact steady. The tone of a teacher who has read your work and wants to hear you talk about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、極度の貧困地域を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually my paper focused on economic systems in impoverished regions.
lines.style: Quiet, careful correction. Slight hesitation before speaking — not defensive, just accurate. Steady eye contact back. Polite firmness that doesn't apologize for the correction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、入植地の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Right — you explored the colonial settlement patterns, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful recalibration. Pause before speaking, like rechecking notes in her head. Warm but not pushy. Genuinely trying to understand his actual research.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、従属国家の経済関係を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, my focus was on the economic relationships between dominant and subordinate nations.
lines.style: Steady, unflustered clarification. No edge to it — just factual. Slight upward inflection at the end like he's gently helping her understand. Patient.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 太平洋戦争の影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see — and the Pacific War was part of your framework?
lines.style: Engaged leaning-in. Like something is clicking into place for her. Not quite a question — more like thinking aloud with him. Genuine intellectual interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、迷信の払拭運動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My paper actually traced how wartime propaganda worked to dismantle superstition and reshape collective belief.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deeper explanation. He's gained confidence now. Voice steadies. Not lecturing — inviting her to follow his logic. Slightly longer breath between clauses.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、多重の人格障害を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ah — so the psychological patterns were central to your argument?
lines.style: Recognition dawning. Quiet 'ah' of understanding. Leaning back slightly, reassessing. Respectful pause. She's following him now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時の憎悪の連鎖を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — how the chain of hatred during wartime operated at the individual and collective level simultaneously.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. This is the core of his thinking. Voice doesn't rush. Precise, almost gentle in delivery. The vulnerable moment where he shares what actually matters to him.
